How Much CBD Should I Take?

When starting a CBD regimen, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated.

You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you.

settings.text_2: Start with 1-6mg for every 10lbs of body weight

settings.text_4: Keep a journal to track your dosage and its effects

settings.text: Ashwagandha is a herb commonly used as an adaptogen to manage stress. Whole-plant extract ashwagandha can significantly reduce cortisol levels, decrease stress improve sleep duration, increase energy, and increase DHEA.

settings.title: What do CBD supplements do for you?
settings.text: CBD supplements interact with the body’s endocannabinoid system, potentially offering a range of health benefits. They can help alleviate symptoms of stress, reduce inflammation, and improve sleep quality. CBD supplements might also provide neuroprotective properties and support heart health. The effectiveness of CBD supplements can vary based on the form, dosage, and individual differences. As a natural supplement, CBD offers an alternative or complementary option for those seeking relief from various conditions or overall wellness support.

settings.title: When Should I take Ashwagandha gummies?
settings.text:
The best time to take Ashwagandha is in the morning, this gives you potent access to the stress relief benefits. However, Ashwagandha can also be taken in the evening or later on to help improve sleep. 

Ashwagandha can have different effects on different individuals (due to it being an adaptogen) which means it might make you feel drowsy if you take too much.

settings.text: Ashwagandha, when it’s being used for the first time may take between 2 - 3 days to work and the full benefits may take several weeks to fully realize. Anecdotally, some people feel benefits immediately and others feel a small benefit that gets stronger over time.
